column3: MT 3:34. Close to the Hebrew; “will they restore for themselves” is rendered “Will they fortify themselves?”
MT 3:37. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies the object “You” in “they have provoked You to anger.”
MT 3:38. Close to the Hebrew; “to its middle” is rendered “up to half its height.”
MT 4:6. The Hebrew is elliptical (“from all the places which you turn to us”); NKJV completes it as “From whatever place you turn, they will be upon us.”
MT 4:10. Close to the Hebrew; נְעָרַי (“young men”) is rendered “servants.”
MT 4:12. Close to the Hebrew; בַּשּׁוֹפָר (“the ram’s horn”) is rendered “the trumpet.”
MT 4:14. Close to the Hebrew; “the ram’s horn” is rendered “the trumpet.”
MT 4:17. The end of the verse is obscure (literally “each one his weapon, the water”); NKJV paraphrases “except that everyone took them off for washing.”
